sources.quote: SUP-G,Minuterie Germanasca S.r.l.,"steel stampings, clips, pins"

findings.why: Viteria Lanzo is not in the supplier master, which lists only SUP-G. Its standing and qualification are unknown, so a person must confirm whether it is in our records.

sources.quote: 4.4 A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for the drawing material.

findings.why: A source change to Viteria Lanzo needs a 3.1 certificate for the CL-115 drawing material. No certificate from Viteria Lanzo is in the documents, so the supplier quality engineer must follow this up.

sources.quote: 4.2 A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: No approved supplier list record is in the documents for Viteria Lanzo, CL-115, a receiving plant or a customer. Absence of a record cannot be read as 'not approved', so a person must check the approved supplier list. The customer and receiving plant are not stated, so the key uses 'unknown' for the customer.
